confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on cost-of-living sites with mixed dates and methods, so they are medium-to-low quality. Beer and hotpot figures are rough. The cocktail anchor rests on a single 2021 club price point. The wine anchor is a beer-relationship estimate because no Chongqing wine price was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no booking pages or listings checked. CNY figures were converted at about 6.7 CNY per USD, the rate implied by the cost-of-living sources. The FX observation (0.6955 USD per AUD for 2026-10-15) came from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange rates page. I could not open that page to confirm the value, so verify it on rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Chongqing-specific basis: restaurant meal and café prices from CityCost and LifeIndexed 2026 pages, hotpot per-person reports, and a 2026 cappuccino estimate. The cocktail anchor uses a 2021 Expatistan downtown club price (47 CNY). The wine anchor is derived from the local beer anchor using a typical bar-to-beer multiple. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge of Chongqing budget hostels and registered budget and mid-range hotels.
